أقتبل (form VIII)

# أُقْتَبَلُ (ʔuqtabalu) /ʔuq.ta.ba.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# أَقْتَبِلَ (ʔaqtabila) /ʔaq.ta.bi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# أُقْتَبَلَ (ʔuqtabala) /ʔuq.ta.ba
